item.title: Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel’s History of Heroes
item.description:
Each copy of Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel’s History of Heroes contains 30 individually packaged Magic cards, each of which represents an era or moment from the history of the Marvel Universe. These cards randomly appear in non-foil, foil, or—when the stars and spells align—surge foil. Price: $199.99 USD November 2, 2026, only on MagicSecretLair.com
